{"consolidated_memory":"MULTIPLE OCCASIONS: Off-by-one day issue in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx—same code area, different root causes and triggers.

**Occasion 1: [2026-04-14]**
- Component: ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web ui side)
- Issue: Off-by-one day in the date picker
- Trigger: Occurred only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Repro: Pick the first of the month and reopen
- Signal: Selected value one day behind the label
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #1031 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Performance outcome: p99 latency fell from 1.3 s to 503 ms

**Occasion 2: [2026-08-02]**
- Component: ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web ui side)
- Issue: Off-by-one day in the date picker
- Trigger: Occurred only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: Pick the first of the month and reopen
- Signal: Selected value one day behind the label
- Root cause: An error swallowed by a bare except clause
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #3374 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Performance outcome: Cold start dropped 56 percent, to 765 ms

Both incidents occurred in the same corner of the DatePicker component; context carried over between them."}
